Description: "Modify the student info grid layout inside the single-page landscape section to occupy only 2 rows."
Instruction: "Change the 4-row info grid to a compact 2-row info grid."
ReplacementContent:
"                        <View style={[styles.singleStudentInfoGrid, isValuesOnly ? { opacity: 0 } : {}]}>
                            <View style={styles.singleInfoRow}>
                                <Text style={{ fontSize: 7.5, width: 30 }}>Name:</Text>
                                <Text style={[styles.singleInfoValue, { flex: 3 }]}>{student.last_name}, {student.first_name} {student.middle_name}</Text>
                                <Text style={{ fontSize: 7.5, width: 25, marginLeft: 8 }}>Age:</Text>
                                <Text style={[styles.singleInfoValue, { flex: 1 }]}>{student.age || ''}</Text>
                                <Text style={{ fontSize: 7.5, width: 25, marginLeft: 8 }}>Sex:</Text>
                                <Text style={[styles.singleInfoValue, { flex: 1 }]}>{student.gender}</Text>
                            </View>
                            <View style={styles.singleInfoRow}>
                                <Text style={{ fontSize: 7.5, width: 30 }}>LRN:</Text>
                                <Text style={[styles.singleInfoValue, { flex: 2 }]}>{student.lrn}</Text>
                                <Text style={{ fontSize: 7.5, width: 30, marginLeft: 8 }}>Grade:</Text>
                                <Text style={[styles.singleInfoValue, { flex: 1 }]}>{student.grade_level.replace('Grade ', '')}</Text>
                                <Text style={{ fontSize: 7.5, width: 35, marginLeft: 8 }}>Section:</Text>
                                <Text style={[styles.singleInfoValue, { flex: 1.5 }]}>{section}</Text>
                                <Text style={{ fontSize: 7.5, width: 20, marginLeft: 8 }}>S.Y.:</Text>
                                <Text style={[styles.singleInfoValue, { flex: 1.5 }]}>{schoolYear}</Text>
                            </View>
                        </View>"
